info.title: Restormel Keys API
info.description:
Zuplo Gateway API for Restormel Keys. Consumer keys (zpka_...) authenticate at the edge; inbound policies forward to the dashboard with a backend Gateway key (rk_...). Control-plane CRUD uses /api/* on KEYS_BACKEND_URL. Runtime hot paths (Phase 1+) use /keys/v1/* on KEYS_SITE_ORIGIN (site root, e.g. https://restormel.dev).

Rate-limit headers: all endpoints with rate-limit-inbound in their policy stack emit X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset on every response. Zuplo emits these automatically; no backend change required.

Changelog:
- 1.7.0 (2026-06-08): [4B] Provenance audit trace export. POST /connect/v1/retrieve and POST /connect/v1/graph now return a trace_id. New GET /connect/v1/traces/{traceId} returns the structured, versioned ProvenanceTrace; GET /connect/v1/traces/{traceId}/export?format=json downloads it. Traces are retained for 90 days.
- 1.6.0 (2026-06-07): [C1] Cursor pagination on GET /connect/v1/ingest/jobs (?limit, ?cursor, next_cursor, total_count). [C2] Idempotency-Key header support on POST /connect/v1/ingest/jobs (24-hour TTL). [C3] X-Request-Id header on all Connect v1, Keys v1, and Graph v1 responses (echoed in error envelopes as request_id). [C4] Rate-limit response headers documented (X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset — Zuplo already emits). [C5] GET /graph/v1/snapshots/{snapshotId} now returns 501 not_implemented instead of 404 (Graph snapshots planned for Phase 6). [1A] Connect v1 ingest/retrieve/verify API with workspace-scoped persistence. [1B] Keys v1 routing surface. [1C] GraphStoreAdapter unification + RetrievalConfig. [1D] Ingest contract completion: quality reports, log streaming, outbound webhooks. [2A] Neo4j adapter + graph store config panel. [2B] O1/O2 breaking changes: contract_version snake_case, /connect/v1/retrieve 206 on degraded.
- 1.1.0 (2026-06-07): [O1 BREAKING] contractVersion field renamed to contract_version (snake_case) in resolve, simulate, and catalog responses. Update any consumers reading this field. [O2 BREAKING] /connect/v1/retrieve now returns HTTP 206 (Partial Content) instead of 200 when retrieval_degraded:true. [I4] /graph/v1/layout now requires authentication (gateway key, management key, or session). [I5] New /keys/v1/management-keys endpoints (POST/GET/DELETE) for management key lifecycle. [I9] GET /keys/v1/connections and GET /keys/v1/connections/{connectionId} now accept gateway keys (read-only).

tags.description: Read-only suite tools mirrored over HTTP (docs, testing, observability, graph, state).

get.description: Returns gateway health status. No auth required.

post.summary: Invoke read-only suite tool (HTTP mirror of MCP)
post.description: Runs a Horizon Phase 1 suite read tool on the dashboard origin (docs canonical resolve, testing config validate, trace summarize, graph fixture validate, state memory preview). Request body: { tool, payload? }. See repo docs/integrations/restormel-suite-tool-envelope.schema.json.

200.description: Tool result JSON (structuredContent-equivalent; may include ok:false and code for tool-level errors)

400.description: Invalid envelope or missing required payload fields

get.description: Returns all projects in the authenticated workspace.

get.summary: List Gateway Keys for a project

201.description: Key created; raw key returned once in response

get.description: Canonical provider+model catalog. Public read; same semantics as GET /keys/dashboard/api/catalog.
Paged model list. Same semantics as GET /keys/dashboard/api/models.

post.summary: Resolve provider/model for a project (Keys v1)
post.description: Runtime route resolution. Gateway key must be scoped to projectId. Same semantics as POST /keys/dashboard/api/projects/{id}/resolve.
Policy evaluation for a model/context. Same semantics as POST /keys/dashboard/api/policies/evaluate.

post.summary: Compute Contract v0 orbital layout (Graph v1)
post.description: Stateless layout from inline GraphData snapshot. Same semantics as in-process computeLayout in @restormel/graph-core. Auth required (I4, 2026-06-07): gateway key, management key, or session.

get.summary: Read hosted graph snapshot metadata (Graph v1)
get.description: Returns 501 Not Implemented until Phase 6 operator persistence ships. Use POST /graph/v1/layout with an inline snapshot today. See restormel.dev/changelog for updates.

message.example: Graph snapshots are not yet available. See restormel.dev/changelog for updates.

post.description: Claim extraction, reasoning evaluation, and constitution checks via @restormel/reasoning-core.

503.description: Verify routes or credentials not configured

post.description:
Deprecated: use POST /connect/v1/graph for full orchestrator support and domain-pack-aware retrieval. This endpoint will be removed in v2.

Graph-aware context assembly via @restormel/graphrag-core (workspace graph index when configured).

200.description: Context block + retrieval metadata (graph store fully resolved)

206.description: [O2, 2026-06-07] Partial Content: retrieval_degraded:true in metadata (graph store not configured, unreachable, or empty). Body shape is identical to 200. Deprecated: previously returned 200 for degraded responses.

post.description: Higher-order graph retrieval via the RetrievalOrchestrator. Supports retrieve_context, expand_context, find_relevant_subgraph, find_paths, and summarise_subgraph operations. Preferred over /connect/v1/retrieve for all new integrations.

200.description: Context block, subgraph/paths, trace, and retrieval metadata

post.description: Creates a new knowledge ingest job. Supports idempotency: include an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string, max 256 chars) to safely retry without creating duplicate jobs. The same key returns the original 201 response for 24 hours.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key. Duplicate requests with the same key within 24 hours return the original response.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of ingest jobs for the workspace. Use `limit` and `cursor` for paging; carry `next_cursor` from each response as `cursor` in the next request.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max results per page. Default 20, max 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from the previous response's next_cursor field.

get.summary: Stream Connect Ingest job logs (Connect v1)
get.description: Incremental, paginated worker log lines. Poll with the previous response's next_since cursor.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Log line cursor; return lines after this index.

get.description: Returns the structured, versioned ProvenanceTrace stored for a retrieval query (POST /connect/v1/retrieve or /connect/v1/graph returns its trace_id). Traces are retained for 90 days.
Downloadable provenance trace. Sets Content-Disposition so the trace saves as a JSON file. Only format=json is supported.

post.summary: Register a Connect ingest webhook (Connect v1)
post.description: Register an outbound webhook fired when an ingest job reaches a terminal state. Payloads are HMAC-SHA256 signed (X-Restormel-Signature: sha256=<hex>). The signing_secret is returned exactly once.

get.summary: Get a Connect ingest webhook (Connect v1)

delete.summary: Delete a Connect ingest webhook (Connect v1)

get.description: List management keys for the authenticated workspace. Session auth required.

200.description: List of management key records (prefix only; no raw key)

post.description: Issue a management key scoped to the caller's workspace. Session auth required. Raw key shown once. Management keys are workspace-scoped; gateway keys are project-scoped.

201.description: Management key created; raw key returned once

delete.description: Revoke a management key by ID. Session auth required. Only the workspace owner may revoke.

get.description: Read-only. Returns source connections for the caller's workspace. Auth: gateway key, management key, or session (I9).
Read-only. Returns a single source connection by ID for the caller's workspace. Auth: gateway key, management key, or session (I9).

consumerKey.description: A Zuplo consumer key (zpka_...). Send as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

ProvenanceTrace.description: Structured, versioned audit trace for a retrieval query. schema_version is bumped only on breaking changes; consumers must tolerate unknown fields.

payload.description: Tool-specific arguments (e.g. topic, content+format, traceJson, graphJson, eventsJson).

environments.description: Optional. Present when expanded by the backend.

KeyInfo.description: A Gateway Key. Full key is shown only at creation time.

QualityReport.description: Ingest quality assessment. Nullable: present only once validation has run for the job.

next_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass as ?cursor= in the next request. Null when no further pages.

total_count.description: Total number of ingest jobs for the workspace (across all pages).

secret.description: Optional signing secret; generated when omitted.

ConnectIngestJob.description: A workspace-scoped Knowledge Ingest job, persisted to Postgres.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique identifier for this request, echoed in error envelopes as request_id. Generated by the server if not present in the incoming request.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the current window resets.
